neighbours.label: a degree or quantity word just before a negative or deficient description (more of a nightmare, well below, a very bad)
fire: The holiday ended up being more of a disaster than a rest.
Their salaries are still far below what the job requires.
Lying under oath is a very serious offence in this country.
The new policy proved much worse than the old one.
His second novel was rather a disappointment to fans.
The harvest fell well short of what farmers had hoped for.
Skipping the check was a truly terrible mistake for the crew.
The repair work turned out to be more of a hassle than expected.
quiet: The holiday ended up being a long rest by the sea.
Their salaries are paid at the end of every month.
Lying in the sun is a popular pastime in this country.
The new policy was announced on Monday morning.
His second novel was published in the spring.
The harvest came in late this year for most farmers.
Skipping breakfast was a habit he picked up at college.
The repair work took place over two weekends in May.

notes: Top tokens ' a', ' more', ' well', ' very' before negative outcomes; also code quote tokens. The + pole fires on negative prefixes (in-, mis-). Probe 0.08-0.23.
